entries.historical_text: R162 permitted DESIGN_NOT_FEASIBLE when the precision target would require more than the predeclared maximum sample.
entries.effective_clarification: For stochastic pilot width screening, an upper certificate above threshold does not establish infeasibility. Use deterministic resource emptiness or min_q H_L>w_max; otherwise output PILOT_INCONCLUSIVE.

entries.historical_text: An independent pilot may select a frozen plan while planwise coverage transports by the tower argument.
entries.effective_clarification: This remains valid for coverage, but pilot independence does not transport residual risk, expected width or the width-optimal plan. Width claims require R165:RESIDUAL_TRANSPORT_PREMISE.

entries.historical_text: R164 left the finite pilot menu and maximum-width/regret rule open.
entries.effective_clarification: R165 closes the formal selection and status logic conditional on a finite menu and transport radii; scientific choice of the menu and empirical validation of transport remain open.
